constraints: Nuxt 2 is end of life; preserve routing, data fetching, build modules, and the TypeScript coverage the project relies on while moving to Nuxt 3.

steps.instructions: Follow the Nuxt 3 migration guidance for pages, plugins, modules, and the build configuration before removing the Nuxt 2 type packages.
steps.title: Plan the Nuxt 3 upgrade

steps.instructions: Remove @nuxt/types once the project runs on Nuxt 3, which ships its own types.
steps.title: Remove the Nuxt 2 type package

verification.purpose: Build the application on Nuxt 3 with its bundled types.
Run the application and repository tests when defined.

rule.summary: npm marks @nuxt/types as deprecated: "Nuxt 2 has reached EOL and is no longer actively maintained. See https://nuxt.com/blog/nuxt2-eol for more details."
rule.title: @nuxt/types is deprecated
